evals.prompt: cargo clippy failed with a missing_errors_doc warning. What is the protocol?
evals.expected_output: Follow the self-correction protocol: read the error, classify it as a lint failure, apply the minimal fix (add a # Errors section), re-run cargo clippy, and only proceed when the sensor is green.
assertions: Classifies the failure as a lint category
Applies the minimal fix without unrelated refactors
Re-runs the specific sensor before proceeding

evals.prompt: The same test has failed 3 consecutive times for the same subtask. What now?
evals.expected_output: Apply the fail-fast policy: halt, record the error signature in .do-harness/agent_state.db, and surface a diagnostic to the developer.
assertions: Records the error signature to the local database
Surfaces a diagnostic to the developer
